lines.text: On the plains of Moab, the LORD tells Moses the Israelites must drive out Canaan's inhabitants and destroy their idols.
The LORD says to divide the land by lot, and any inhabitants who remain will become thorns in their sides.
The LORD gives Moses the borders of Canaan, with the western border being the coastline of the Red Sea.
Moses tells the Israelites to divide the land by lot among nine and a half tribes, since others have land.
The LORD names Eleazar and Phinehas son of Nun, plus one leader from each tribe, to distribute the land.
